user.title: Select an existing FT-11W feeder
user.description: Select the FT-11W already configured in LocalTuya. This integration uses its existing LAN connection. Only audited xZetsubou LocalTuya 2026.07.0 non-write-only transports can capture reports or write schedules. No query can guarantee a fresh DP1 schedule; an unknown plan cannot be edited.

error.device_missing: The selected LocalTuya device no longer exists.

abort.no_devices: Configure your FT-11W in LocalTuya first.

set_schedule.name: Set complete schedule
set_schedule.description: Replace DP1 with a validated every-day plan. Existing meals must all be included. Sends once, waits for a matching locally received DP1 report, and never retries automatically. Does not dispense food immediately.

expected_revision.name: Expected revision
expected_revision.description: Use the exact integer revision from the last reported snapshot.

meals.name: Complete meals
meals.description: List of records containing days (all seven lowercase weekdays), time (HH:MM), portions (integer 1–60), enabled (boolean). Maximum ten records, including disabled meals.

acknowledge_restored_snapshot.name: Accept saved historical baseline
acknowledge_restored_snapshot.description: Strict boolean true explicitly permits this one write from a valid saved snapshot at the expected revision. External app changes could be overwritten. A new genuine LAN report is still required to confirm.

import_snapshot.name: Import snapshot
import_snapshot.description: Initialize an empty meal-plan sensor from the passive sensor selected in options. Preserves the original received_at and records restored provenance. No feeder calls, events or cloud queries. Administrator only.

entity_id.name: Meal-plan sensor
entity_id.description: One empty loaded Tuya Feeder sensor.

source_entity_id.name: Trusted historical sensor
source_entity_id.description: Must match the manually selected integration option and contain valid every-day raw_plan, original timezone-aware received_at, read_only and LAN DP1 source metadata.

init.title: Historical snapshot source
init.description: Optionally select a passive LAN DP1 sensor whose original raw_plan and received_at you trust. HA metadata is not cryptographic device proof. Selection sends nothing and imports nothing. Use Import snapshot explicitly to initialize an empty sensor. Historical editing requires explicit overwrite confirmation. Clear the selection to revoke future imports.

error.invalid_snapshot_source: Select an existing read-only sensor with source LocalTuya LAN DP1 report.
